title: Services
description: Web systems, APIs, automation, infrastructure, technical consulting and documentation.

items.title: Custom web systems
items.body: Full-stack applications with authentication, relational/NOSQL database, admin panel and front-end integration (React/Next.js).
specs: Deployment on VPS or cloud (AWS, GCP)

items.title: APIs and integrations
items.body: REST and GraphQL APIs, webhook endpoints, queue systems, retry and structured logging for system integration.

items.title: Automation and ETL
items.body: Automation scripts (Python, Node), task scheduling (cron, jobs) and data orchestration between tools (ETL/ELT).
specs: Scheduling via cron or job schedulers

items.title: Migration and modernization
items.body: Legacy system migration, code refactoring, dependency and stack upgrades, and replatforming.

items.title: Audit and technical consulting
items.body: Architecture review, performance and scalability analysis, security assessment (OWASP basic) and best practices recommendations.

items.title: Technical documentation and UX writing
items.body: API documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger), user manuals, internal wikis and functional specifications.

items.title: MVP and prototyping
items.body: Rapid development of functional prototypes and MVPs for product hypothesis validation with short feedback cycles.
